<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def grid_of(fr):
    g = {}
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        b = n['boundary']
        r0,r1 = min(p[0] for p in b), max(p[0] for p in b)
        c0,c1 = min(p[1] for p in b), max(p[1] for p in b)
        if n['pixels']==4:
            g[(r0,c0)] = n['color']
        elif n['pixels']==10:
            g[('N',r0,c0)] = n['color']
    return g
before = grid_of(previous_frame)
res = action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':26,'col':14}])
after = grid_of(current_frame)
print("result:", {k:res.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','done','level_completed','reward','score')})
diff = []
for k in set(before)|set(after):
    if before.get(k) != after.get(k):
        diff.append((k, before.get(k), after.get(k)))
print("diffs:", diff)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

def grid_of(fr):
    g = {}
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        b = n['boundary']
        r0,r1 = min(p[0] for p in b), max(p[0] for p in b)
        c0,c1 = min(p[1] for p in b), max(p[1] for p in b)
        if n['pixels']==4:
            g[(r0,c0)] = n['color']
        elif n['pixels']==10:
            g[('N',r0,c0)] = n['color']
    return g
